ambient_behaviors.trigger: Prompt build with a non-empty workspaceDir
ambient_behaviors.launch_behavior: Calls `ix briefing --format text`, caches the result for 10 minutes per workspace, and prepends `[ix] Session briefing:` plus the text, capped at 2,000 characters, on the first prompt build per workspace in each 10-minute window when briefing data is available.
ambient_behaviors.failure_mode: Returns no injection when workspaceDir is absent, Ix Pro is unavailable, or the briefing call fails.
ambient_behaviors.claude_delta: Claude triggers briefing on `UserPromptSubmit` and also instructs Claude to append a final Ix summary when hooks helped. OpenClaw launch baseline only prepends context.

ambient_behaviors.trigger: read and exec tool calls (OpenClaw has no Grep or Glob tool)
ambient_behaviors.launch_behavior: No Ix context is injected for search tools. A before_tool_call handler can only rewrite params, block, or request approval (PluginHookBeforeToolCallResult); it has no field that adds context for the model.
ambient_behaviors.failure_mode: Always a silent no-op at launch.
ambient_behaviors.claude_delta: Claude front-runs Grep/Glob and grep-like Bash calls with Ix search context. OpenClaw does not yet replicate that behavior.
ambient_behaviors.notes: The folder hooks that described this (`hooks/ix-intercept`, `hooks/ix-read`, `hooks/ix-bash`) subscribed to `before_tool_call`, which folder hooks never receive, and were removed in 2.4.2. Runtime behavior is defined by `plugins/ix-plugin.ts`.

ambient_behaviors.trigger: OpenClaw `edit`, `write`, and `apply_patch` calls on non-skipped paths
ambient_behaviors.launch_behavior: Runs `ix-decide` for the touched paths (every file of an `apply_patch`; relative paths resolved against the agent workspace). `REVIEW` returns an OpenClaw approval request (severity `critical`, title marked high risk, for what used to be a `BLOCK`). Nothing returns `{ block: true }`. `ALLOW` returns no intervention.
ambient_behaviors.failure_mode: Skips markdown, text, lockfiles, common binary assets, and compiled artifacts. If no target path is found, it returns no intervention.
ambient_behaviors.claude_delta: Claude surfaces a warning-oriented pre-edit hook. OpenClaw launch baseline requires explicit approval for risky edits; it never hard-blocks.

ambient_behaviors.trigger: Successful `edit`, `write`, and `apply_patch` calls on non-skipped paths
ambient_behaviors.launch_behavior: Requests the guarded root map (`runtime/auto-map.ts`): `ix map <git root> --silent` in the background with `IX_AUTO_MAP=1`, only when the edited file's directory (relative paths resolved against the agent workspace) is inside a git repo whose root is not $HOME, `ix status --format json --root <root>` reports `graphCompleted: true`, and no automatic map started for that root in the last 5 minutes. Never `ix map <file>`, which Ix rejects. No user-visible output is emitted.
ambient_behaviors.failure_mode: Returns silently when the tool errored, the path is skipped, no target path can be derived, or any guard fails.
ambient_behaviors.claude_delta: Functionally similar to Claude's async post-edit ingest hook.

ambient_behaviors.trigger: OpenClaw session end with an agent id whose workspace the SDK resolves (`runtime.agent.resolveAgentWorkspaceDir`)
ambient_behaviors.launch_behavior: Requests the same guarded root map for the agent's workspace directory. The session transcript directory is never mapped. No user-visible output is emitted.
ambient_behaviors.failure_mode: Returns silently when the workspace cannot be resolved or any guard fails.
ambient_behaviors.claude_delta: Claude runs a graph refresh on `Stop` and also has a separate final Ix annotation hook. OpenClaw launch baseline refreshes the graph only.
